- Quantities, dates, and the polarity of each claim (staff view vs. authorities' view vs. neutral description) are recorded.
- Each disposition names exactly one locator and an inclusive segment range. The segment IDs selected are the narrowest contiguous ranges that fully support each claim.
- Limitations flag where figures are staff estimates, model simulations, or proposed-but-not-enacted reforms, so downstream consumers do not over-weight them.
- No scoring has been applied; this is calibration-only extraction.
